integrity: The additive presentation is regenerated from the published Hall-basis presentation, including ideal closure of the defining relators and all stated weight-four relations. No numerical approximation is used.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the underlying additive group of the explicit N=1 plateau example. It does not give a formula for N>1. The exact verification uses an integer Smith-normal-form implementation and has not been independently reproduced.
title: Additive invariant factors of the first finite-plateau Lie ring
